Insightful Evocation Focus +1: +1 Insight bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Insightful Wizardry +31: +31 Insight bonus to spell points.
Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +30 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
Deadly Diabolist: 2 Pieces Equipped: Your Summons, Charmed Monsters, and Hirelings gain +4 to all Ability Scores.
